drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is a revised draft with proposed definitions of “cause” and “benefits.” Base Salary and Severance Amount remain bracketed pending client confirmation. We have also narrowed the non-compete for discussion and flagged applicable law for agreement.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of USD [amount to be agreed] (the “Base Salary”), payable under the Company’s regular payroll practices, and the benefits defined below. “Benefits” means participation, subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements, in the employee benefit plans the Company generally makes available to similarly situated executives.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Executive shall receive USD [amount to be agreed] (the “Severance Amount”), subject to applicable withholding and execution of a customary release of claims. “Cause” means the Executive’s (a) conviction of, or plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony; (b) fraud or willful misconduct that materially harms the Company; (c) material breach of this Agreement; or (d) willful and continued failure to perform material duties after written notice and 30 days to cure, where cure is possible.

4. NON-COMPETE. For twelve months following termination of employment, the Executive shall not perform substantially similar duties for a business that directly competes with the Company in a market in which the Executive had material responsibilities during the final twelve months of employment, solely to the extent permitted by applicable law. The parties will specify the governing law and revisit the duration and scope before execution.

receiver.message_back: We can discuss Base Salary and the Severance Amount once the parties have confirmed the applicable governing law. For Vireo, we propose that any severance be conditioned on an effective release, that material breaches be subject to a cure period only where curable, and that the non-compete’s duration and scope be finalized under that law before execution.

delivered.body: Executive Employment Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. and the Executive. 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer. 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive the Base Salary set out below plus benefits. 3. SEVERANCE. On termination without cause the Executive receives the Severance Amount below. 4. NON-COMPETE. The Executive shall not compete for twelve months after departure.
